# T4 Studio for VS Code

Syntax highlighting for `.tt` and `.t4` text template files.

## Features

- Syntax highlighting for T4 directives (`<#@ ... #>`), expressions (`<#= ... #>`), class features (`<#+ ... #>`), and control blocks (`<# ... #>`)
- Embedded C# syntax highlighting within template blocks
- Block comment support (`<#--` / `--#>`)
- Bracket matching and auto-closing for T4 tags
- Breakpoint support for T4 template files

## Supported File Types

- `.tt` — T4 text templates
- `.t4` — T4 include files
